descripcion: Pixel Camera turns Video Boost off every time you close it, so it never stays on. This app re-enables it automatically each time you open the camera in video mode. No root. Free and open source (MIT), no ads and no tracking. For Pixel 8 Pro, 9 Pro and 10 Pro.
